attempts.attempt-01: Fixture attempted to relocate the immutable CAS root. Native catalog refused the changed binding; retained 14 setup errors. No positive inference claim.
attempts.attempt-02: Fixture preserved the exact original immutable CAS binding, opened only a copied mutable source database, imported model artifacts into a fresh registry and passed all 14 controls.

mapping.actual_pinned_decoder: Fresh isolated CPU workers load the retained registered numerical child and exact local GTE snapshot. Three source-only rows produce qualified candidates with target_access=false and teacher_forcing=false; real Lake compiles all three.
mapping.current_source_join: Prior eight-test fit/inference qualification supplies exact current-head/source fences, immutable corpus, native registry lineage and fresh-process replay. This matrix imports that exact parent/child into a new registry and replays its historical source corpus from a copied source database and original read-only immutable CAS.
mapping.exact_dependencies: Public replay identity retains the exact parent/child/version/checkpoint, source head, embedding asset and producer closure hashes. Both worker receipts retain actual execution and zero provider calls.
mapping.model_off: A separately named deterministic source-label baseline derives AST/native ProgramIR targets from captured source while worker, training, embedding and decoder tripwires are installed. Its three selected targets pass real Lake without a learned-prediction claim. The inference API explicitly rejects an unsupported model_off option.
mapping.teacher_substitution: Six controls inject target, teacher_forcing or source_contract fields at the worker source-only boundary and at the decoder embedding boundary. Every closed schema refuses the extra field. These are boundary negative controls, not teacher-generated predictions.
mapping.unsupported_candidates: Removing required integer input annotations from the source retains the actual decoded candidate and candidate digest, reports unsupported and blocks Lake without dropping the row.
mapping.wrong_codebook: A structurally valid altered operator vocabulary with unchanged tensor dimensions passes Runtime structural validation, then fails the registered child-parent vocabulary invariant. The original parent and child remain unchanged and no promotion occurs.
mapping.wrong_source: An actual decoded report cannot compile against changed source under the old digest. Rehashing the changed source and forging an attached successful source contract also fails independent source replay; the exact original candidate is retained and no Lake process runs.
mapping.zero_head: The exact learned worker is rerun with zero_head: all three actual outputs mismatch their source and remain unchanged through the Lake refusal gate; no source label or teacher target substitutes for the wrong prediction.

privacy: Retains only public source/proof/inference receipts, hashes, test logs and Lean source. No mutable source/model databases, CAS stores, scheduler state, private owner credentials or checkpoint weight payloads.
resource_admission: Actual proof-host sampler and shared scheduler for isolated numerical workers; no fake capacity or disabled safety. Parent vocabulary and inference boundary negative controls execute locally.
scope_limits: Three two-operand annotated arithmetic examples exercise a fixed typed scalar vocabulary inherited from the shared SecurityIR 384D decoder; this is not arbitrary Python coverage or held-out reconstruction improvement.
Lake checks emitted definitions and types; it does not establish Python equivalence, security correctness or proof/admission authority.
The model-off route is an explicit deterministic comparison baseline, not a new deployed infer_current_source384 option.
The new wrong-source controls exercise independent qualification of actual learned outputs; they do not claim to authenticate arbitrary caller-provided inference reports.

Current repository inference is covered by the prior eight-test evidence; this additive run deliberately replays the archived historical source generation without restoring or mutating its dirty repository.
